title: The Farmer Was Replaced by Claude
paragraph: The Farmer Was Replaced is a video game where you control a drone in a farming field by writing Python code. It’s a great and fun way to learn programming fundamentals through a farming game simulator. When it was released on Steam it blew up on Twitter. I remember watching videos of people spawning drone threads, solving maze, creating libraries, optimizing their drones to harvest with full efficiency. Since it is a programming game it got me thinking, “What happens if I let Claude play the game?”

title: Stop Developing Games!
paragraph: Like most Computer Science student, we love games and even chose this path with hope to create our own Minecraft, GTA V, Pokémon. The problem is you can’t just create a game with an idea. When you got great ideas for a game, you fail to implement certain systems. When you finish the system, it looks trash cause you’re not an artists. When you finish the artwork, it feels empty cause you’re not a sound designer. As a solo developer this kind of problem leaves me with many unfinished projects.
